p: divided the children unto Leah: That if the one part were assailed, the other might escape.
bowed himself to the ground seven: By this gesture he partly revered his brother and partly prayed to God to appease Esau's wrath.
bowed themselves: Jacob and his family are the image of the Church under the yoke of tyrants who out of fear are brought to subjection.
I have seen thy face: In that his brother embraced him so lovingly, contrary to his expectation, he accepted it as a clear sign of God's presence.
I come unto my lord unto: He promised that which (as it would seem) he did not plan to do.
it Elelohe-Israel: He calls the sign, the thing which it signifies, in token that God had mightily delivered him.
